metadata.title: Product Bricks & Streams
metadata.description: Brick map of zvoove's private-security ERP (Freematica e-Satellite) for Spain and Latin America: Quote -> Contract -> Roster -> Cover -> Patrol and report -> Comply -> Pay -> Bill -> Steer.

bricks.name: Security Service Quote Costing
bricks.description: Prices a security service from post hours, night and holiday shares, guard category and convenio wage costs, plus supervision and equipment - so tenders are won without selling below cost.

modules.name: Quote Sheet
modules.description: Hour and cost build-up per post.

modules.name: Cost Engine
modules.description: Applies convenio wage tables and surcharges to hour profiles.

bricks.name: Security Service Contracts and Post Orders
bricks.description: Client contracts broken into services and posts (puestos) with hours, guard category, armed/unarmed, required qualifications and post orders (consignas) that guards must follow.

modules.name: Contract and Post Editor
modules.description: Services, posts, schedules and post orders per client site.

modules.name: Service Contract API
modules.description: Contracts, services, posts and post orders.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for contracts and posts.
System of record for post orders.

bricks.name: Guard Rostering (Cuadrantes)
bricks.description: Builds monthly and annual rosters that cover every post 24/7 with guards who hold the right licence and training, respect convenio rest and annual-hour rules and rotate fairly. Freematica claims 33% less scheduling time.

modules.name: Roster Grid
modules.description: Posts by day and shift with assigned guards and rule warnings.

modules.name: Roster Solver
modules.description: Generates rosters under licence, rest, annual-hour and rotation constraints.

bricks.name: Real-Time Post Coverage Monitoring
bricks.description: Compares the roster with live clock-ins and raises alerts when a post is uncovered or double-covered, then proposes relief guards.

modules.name: Gap Detector
modules.description: Detects missing clock-ins against the roster.

modules.name: Relief Finder
modules.description: Finds nearby licensed guards within hour limits.

bricks.name: Patrol Rounds and Checkpoints
bricks.description: Digital rounds with NFC/QR checkpoints and GPS validation, photos and comments, proving that patrols happened as agreed.

modules.name: Round Designer
modules.description: Checkpoints, routes and frequencies per site.

modules.name: Missed Round Alert
modules.description: Alerts when a round is late or incomplete.

modules.name: Round Execution Service
modules.description: Checkpoint scans with time and location.

bricks.name: Incident and Daily Reports
bricks.description: Guards report incidents and daily logs (partes) with photos; supervisors review and escalate; clients receive reports. Freematica claims 70% fewer incidents reported by clients or audits.

modules.name: Incident Review
modules.description: Queue of incidents with severity and escalation.

modules.name: Escalation Notifier
modules.description: Notifies supervisors and client contacts by severity.

bricks.name: Control Room Console
bricks.description: Central view for supervisors: coverage, rounds, incidents and guard messages across all sites, with task dispatch.

modules.name: Control Console
modules.description: Map and list of posts, alerts and tasks.

bricks.name: Guard Mobile App
bricks.description: App for vigilantes: roster, post orders, clock-in, rounds, incident reporting, payslips and messages.

modules.name: Guard App
modules.description: Roster, post orders, rounds and reports.

modules.name: Guard App BFF
modules.description: Aggregates roster, rounds, incidents and payslips.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Apple App Store and Google Play

bricks.name: Licences, Qualifications and Training
bricks.description: Tracks each guard's professional identity card (TIP) and habilitations, weapon permits, specialisations and mandatory refresher training, and blocks rostering of guards whose licences are missing or expired.

modules.name: Licence Register
modules.description: Licences, permits and training per guard with expiry.

modules.name: Expiry Monitor
modules.description: Warns before licences and training expire.

bricks.name: Regulatory Reporting to Security Authorities
bricks.description: Produces the records and reports security authorities audit: Spain's Policía Nacional private-security unit (Segurpri) audits and service communications, Colombia's Supervigilancia and Mexico's federal private-security registry, via reports and open APIs.

modules.name: Report Builder
modules.description: Builds reports from contracts, rosters and licences.

modules.name: Authority Connector
modules.description: Submission channels and open APIs to authority platforms.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Security authorities (Policía Nacional / Segurpri, Supervigilancia, SSPC)

bricks.name: Time and Presence Control
bricks.description: Legally compliant time recording (Spain's mandatory registro de jornada) by app, terminal or phone, with GPS and site validation.

bricks.name: Employee Records, Documents and e-Signature
bricks.description: Employee master data, contracts, subrogation files when contracts change supplier, documents and digital signature.

rootGroups.name: Pay, Bill and Insight
rootGroups.description: Payroll, invoices, profitability and client transparency.

bricks.name: Multi-Convention Security Payroll
bricks.description: Payroll that applies the security collective agreement and others (night, holiday, weekend, danger and weapon premiums, annual-hour balancing, rotations) across several conventions and countries; Freematica claims 40% fewer payroll and billing errors.

modules.name: Convention API
modules.description: Wage tables and premiums by convention.

modules.name: Gross-to-Net Service
modules.description: ES, MX and CO tax and social security.

bricks.name: Service-Based Invoicing
bricks.description: Invoices from services rendered and covered hours against contract terms, including extras and penalties, with e-invoicing per country.

modules.name: e-Invoice Connector
modules.description: Spanish Facturae/Verifactu, Mexican CFDI and Colombian electronic invoicing.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Tax authority e-invoicing systems (AEAT, SAT, DIAN)

bricks.name: Profitability by Client, Service and Branch
bricks.description: Margin by client, service, post and branch from payroll cost, hours and invoices.

bricks.name: Client Security Portal
bricks.description: Secure client access to service validations, rounds, incident reports and documentation.

modules.name: Client Portal BFF
modules.description: Aggregates rounds, incidents, coverage and invoices.

bricks.name: Integration Hub and Open API
bricks.description: Open API and event bus connecting HR, access control, accounting, risk prevention and authority platforms.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.system: Customer HR, access-control and accounting systems

bricks.name: Tenant and Country Packs (Spain, Mexico, Colombia)
bricks.description: Tenants, roles and country packs for labour law, conventions, e-invoicing and security regulation in Spain, Mexico and Colombia.
